requirements.summary: Each cached IA observation must have a stable source observation ID.
Each observation must record when it was observed.
Each observation must record the policy version that allowed the request.
Raw responses must have a deterministic hash for cache integrity.
Raw cache retention, redaction, and reset behavior must be explicit.
A normalized summary must be derived without claiming accepted truth.
Cache TTL must be recorded and enforced.
A local reset command must exist before source-cache writes are enabled.
